name: Otter AI
one_liner: Otter.ai offers a REST API for Enterprise customers to upload audio, retrieve transcripts, summaries, and action items, and a Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants to query meeting data.
auth_notes: All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. OAuth 2.0 access token as `Authorization: Bearer …`.
access_notes: Otter.ai’s Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces. If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager.
